mapper.select: SELECT MAX(tenant_code) FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code LIKE #{value} || '%' AND tenant_code ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant ( tenant_code, tenant_nm, admin_email, corporate_number, business_type, business_category, onboarding_status ) VALUES ( #{tenantSerialCode}, #{tenantNm}, #{adminEmail}, #{corporateNumber}, #{businessType}, #{businessCategory}, 'EMAIL_QUEUED' )
mapper.select: SELECT u.email_adres FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = li.user_id WHERE li.login_account_id = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant SET onboarding_status = #{onboardingStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
UPDATE tb_login_account SET onboarding_status = #{onboardingStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE login_account_id = #{loginAccountId}

UPDATE tb_login_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_algo = #{passwordAlgo}, use_at = #{useAt}, onboarding_status = #{onboardingStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE login_account_id = #{loginAccountId}
UPDATE tb_user SET mobile_no = #{mobileNo}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = ( SELECT user_id FROM tb_login_account WHERE login_account_id = #{loginAccountId} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tenant WHERE use_at = 'Y' AND NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(corporate_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') = #{value}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tenant WHERE 1=1
AND tenant_code ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND COALESCE(admin_email, '') ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND tenant_nm ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND use_at = 'Y'
AND use_at = 'N'
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') = #{onboardingStatus}
AND use_at = #{useAtOnly}

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_nm AS company_name, '-' AS admin_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(admin_email), ''), '-') AS admin_email, CASE WHEN use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, corporate_number, business_type, business_category FROM tb_tenant WHERE 1=1
AND tenant_code ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND COALESCE(admin_email, '') ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND tenant_nm ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND use_at = 'Y'
AND use_at = 'N'
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') = #{onboardingStatus}
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize})

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_nm AS company_name, corporate_number AS business_registration_number, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(admin_email), ''), '-') AS admin_email, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS issued_at FROM tb_tenant ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_nm, admin_email, corporate_number, business_type, business_category, logo_image, onboarding_status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, use_at FROM tb_tenant WHERE use_at = 'Y' AND SUBSTRING(admin_email FROM POSITION('@' IN admin_email) + 1) = #{domain} LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_nm, admin_email, corporate_number, business_type, business_category, logo_image, onboarding_status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, use_at FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant SET logo_image = #{logoImage}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
